mechanism_narrative: Four consecutive weekly declines in TRANSIT mobility signal a persistent contraction in discretionary trip-making that propagates to retail and recreation, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks than over the last four.
failure_condition: TRANSIT continues to decline or remains below -20 for four weeks while RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS crossing from positive to negative territory marks a behavioral threshold where outdoor leisure trips collapse; because this substitution does not offset lost discretionary activity, RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below 0 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: PARKS remains below 0 for two consecutive weeks while RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of TRANSIT below -20 and RESIDENTIAL above +3 identifies a stay-at-home regime that suppresses commuting and discretionary errands, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: When TRANSIT is below -20 and RESIDENTIAL above +3, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A workplace-mobility rebound from -22.7 to -12.1 under easing restrictions restores weekday commuter routines, which raises retail and recreation footfall over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES improves by more than 5 points from its prior four-week mean
failure_condition: WORKPLACES improves by more than 5 points but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp PARKS decline from +20.3 to -8.0 reflects a seasonal shift from outdoor leisure to indoor activity, reallocating spending toward retail and recreation over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: PARKS falls below 0 and remains there while RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not higher than over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: High GROCERY_PHARM above +9 combined with RESIDENTIAL above +3 indicates essential-only shopping behavior; absent a shift to discretionary trips, RETAIL_REC remains lower over the next week.
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM is above +9 and RESIDENTIAL above +3, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is higher than over the last 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT falling below -22 marks a threshold of severe transit avoidance that reinforces localized and stay-home trip patterns, reducing retail and recreation mobility over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -22 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: TRANSIT falls below -22 but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: Continued WORKPLACES below -10 together with RESIDENTIAL above +3.5 signals that restrictions keep commuters home, sustaining weak retail and recreation mobility over the next week.
failure_condition: When WORKPLACES is below -10 and RESIDENTIAL above +3.5, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is higher than over the last 7 days.
